verdict.summary: Version 2 fixes 10 of the 28 round-1 findings (SP-1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 21). The loop argument is now the contract's own text: Exit and Repeat equal stage_spec and REPEAT, verified. The criterion-coverage, deps, check-row and na rules the gate applies are stated and anchored. The open assumption A8 prints whole, and the Improve mention is gone. Six are partly fixed (SP-2, 5, 8, 20, 22, 24) and twelve are open. What still blocks landing is mostly what `requires` misses. revisit_block is refuse-class at 1,500 with no summary bound anywhere: live test-spec summaries reach 1,431, and today's code excerpts at 600, so a send-back can stall the run. A target with no platform card has no rendering.
